newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - IAT Multimedia gains.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - IAT Multimedia gains.

text.p: Shares of IAT Multimedia Inc shot up 2-3/4, or 45.8 percent, over their offering price of $6 a share, to trade at 8-3/4 in the afternoon on volume of around 1.6 million shares.
The number of shares was raised to 3.35 million from 3.1 million in a deal lead-managed by Royce Investment Group.
The estimated pricing range, according to the company's prospectus, was $6.25 to $6.50 per share.

Switzerland-based IAT makes customizable visual communications systems for use in desktop computers. According to the company's filing, its systems allow users to hold multi-point video conferences in two or more locations and provide additional video, audio and data transfer features not available in traditional video conferencing systems.

According to David Menlow, president of Springfield, N.J.-based IPO Financial Network Corp, the impetus behind the deal's healthy debut was the reputation of the underwriter. "The story behind IAT is the history of Royce Investment."
Menlow said that Royce has established itself as a successful niche player in the IPO market that takes on a limited number of smaller-sized deals and places them "the right way."

He cited recent opening successes like Birman Managed Care Inc, which priced at $5 a share and rose to 7-1/8 on the first day, and Marquee Group Inc, whose shares also priced at $5 and climbed to 7-1/2 at their debut.
